title: Preserve settings filesystem failure cause and distinguish write refusals
outcome: Preserve settings filesystem failure cause and distinguish write refusals
acceptance: Task-sync filesystem refusals retain a bounded useful cause and distinguish read/admission failures from create/write/sync/rename failures; write-stage refusals use setting_write_failed or an explicit equivalent.
A non-standard project-store location has a distinct clear refusal; tests pin a real write/rename failure code and confirm no loss of prior settings bytes.
